paracetamol.name: Paracetamol
paracetamol.drug_class: Analgesic aur antipyretic (dard aur bukhar kam karne wali)
paracetamol.use: Bukhar, sir dard, body pain jaise halke se medium dard.
paracetamol.dose: Adult: 500-1000 mg har 4-6 ghante mein. Max 4 g (4000 mg) in 24 ghante; safe side par 3 g/din tak rakhna behtar hai. Dolo 650 ki ek goli = 650 mg.
paracetamol.timing: Khali pet ya khane ke baad, dono chalega. Do doses ke beech kam se kam 4 ghante ka gap.
paracetamol.side_effects: Normal dose mein kam. Zyada dose se liver damage (serious). Kabhi-kabhi rash.
paracetamol.food: Alcohol ke saath avoid karein (liver risk).
paracetamol.avoid_if: Liver disease ya roz sharab peene walon mein doctor se poochkar hi lein.
paracetamol.warnings: Cold-flu medicines mein bhi paracetamol hota hai, double dose na lein. 3 din se zyada bukhar rahe toh doctor ko dikhayein.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.drug_class: NSAID (dard aur sujan kam karne wali)
ibuprofen.use: Dard, sujan, bukhar, period ka dard, dant ka dard.
ibuprofen.dose: Adult: 200-400 mg har 6-8 ghante mein; bina doctor ke max 1200 mg/din.
ibuprofen.timing: Hamesha khane ya doodh ke saath ya baad mein.
ibuprofen.side_effects: Acidity, pet dard, ulcer/bleeding ka risk, kidney par asar, BP badh sakta hai.
ibuprofen.food: Khali pet na lein. Alcohol se acidity aur bleeding ka risk badhta hai.
ibuprofen.avoid_if: Ulcer/acidity, kidney disease, heart failure, NSAID se badhne wala asthma, pregnancy (khaskar last 3 mahine), dengue.
ibuprofen.warnings: Diclofenac/aspirin jaise dusre NSAID ke saath na lein. Combiflam mein ibuprofen aur paracetamol dono hote hain. Kam se kam dose, kam din ke liye.

diclofenac.name: Diclofenac
diclofenac.use: Joint/muscle dard, sujan, sprain, post-operative dard.
diclofenac.dose: Adult: 50 mg din mein 2-3 baar (max 150 mg/din). SR 100 mg din mein ek baar.
diclofenac.side_effects: Acidity, pet dard, chakkar, kidney/liver par asar; lambe use mein heart risk.
diclofenac.food: Khali pet na lein; alcohol se bachein.
diclofenac.avoid_if: Ulcer, heart disease, kidney disease, pregnancy, NSAID-sensitive asthma.
diclofenac.warnings: Bina doctor ke lambe time tak na lein. Dusre NSAID ke saath na lein.

aspirin.name: Aspirin
aspirin.use: Dard/bukhar, aur heart attack/stroke se bachav (doctor ke kehne par).
aspirin.dose: Dard/bukhar: 325-650 mg zarurat par. Heart protection: 75-150 mg roz ek baar, sirf doctor ke kehne par.
aspirin.timing: Khane ke baad. Enteric-coated goli poori nigalein, todein ya chabayein nahi.
aspirin.side_effects: Acidity, ulcer, bleeding, zyada dose mein kaan mein ringing.
aspirin.food: Alcohol se stomach bleeding ka risk badhta hai.
aspirin.avoid_if: 16 saal se kam bachche (Reye syndrome), dengue, bleeding disorder, ulcer, pregnancy, aspirin allergy.
aspirin.warnings: Surgery ya dental procedure se pehle doctor ko batayein.

cetirizine.name: Cetirizine
cetirizine.use: Allergy, chheenk, naak behna, khujli, urticaria.
cetirizine.dose: Adult: 10 mg din mein ek baar.
cetirizine.timing: Raat ko sone se pehle behtar, kyunki neend aa sakti hai.
cetirizine.side_effects: Neend, mooh sukhna, thakaan, sir dard.
cetirizine.avoid_if: Kidney disease mein dose kam hoti hai, doctor se poochein.
cetirizine.warnings: Gaadi ya machine chalane se pehle dhyan rakhein. Levocetirizine ke saath na lein (same family).

levocetirizine.name: Levocetirizine
levocetirizine.dose: Adult: 5 mg din mein ek baar.
levocetirizine.avoid_if: Severe kidney disease mein avoid/dose adjust.
levocetirizine.warnings: Cetirizine ke saath na lein. Gaadi chalane se pehle dhyan rakhein.

pantoprazole.name: Pantoprazole
pantoprazole.use: Acidity, GERD, ulcer, NSAID se bachav.
pantoprazole.dose: Adult: 40 mg din mein ek baar (ya doctor ke anusar).
pantoprazole.timing: Subah khali pet, naashte se 30-60 minute pehle.
pantoprazole.side_effects: Sir dard, loose motion ya kabz, lambe use mein B12, magnesium, calcium kam ho sakte hain.
pantoprazole.food: Goli khane se pehle leni hai, phir naashta karein.
pantoprazole.warnings: Bina doctor ke mahino tak na lein. Lagatar acidity ke saath vajan girna ya nigalne mein dikkat ho toh doctor ko dikhayein.

omeprazole.name: Omeprazole
omeprazole.dose: Adult: 20 mg din mein ek baar (kabhi 40 mg).
omeprazole.side_effects: Sir dard, pet dard, loose motion; lambe use mein B12/magnesium kam.
omeprazole.warnings: Clopidogrel ke saath avoid (asar kam kar sakta hai); pantoprazole behtar vikalp hai.

domperidone.name: Domperidone
domperidone.dose: Adult: 10 mg din mein 3 baar, max 30 mg/din.
domperidone.side_effects: Mooh sukhna, pet dard; kabhi-kabhi dil ki dhadkan mein badlav (QT).
domperidone.avoid_if: Heart rhythm problem, liver disease, GI bleeding ya blockage.
domperidone.warnings: Lambe din ke liye nahi. Azithromycin jaisi QT badhane wali dawaon ke saath dhyan rakhein.

ondansetron.name: Ondansetron
ondansetron.use: Tez ulti aur nausea (infection, chemo, surgery ke baad).
ondansetron.dose: Adult: 4-8 mg, zarurat par har 8 ghante mein.
ondansetron.timing: Khane se pehle ya bina khane ke. MD/mouth-dissolving goli zubaan par rakhein.
ondansetron.avoid_if: Heart rhythm (QT) problem. Pregnancy mein doctor se poochein.

amoxicillin.name: Amoxicillin
amoxicillin.use: Gale, kaan, chest, urinary aur dant ke bacterial infection.
amoxicillin.dose: Adult: 250-500 mg har 8 ghante mein, doctor ke anusar.
amoxicillin.timing: Khane ke saath ya bina. Pet kharab ho toh khane ke saath.
amoxicillin.warnings: Poora course khatam karein, beech mein na chhodein. Rash, sujan ya saans mein dikkat ho toh turant doctor ke paas jayein.

amoxiclav.name: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic acid
amoxiclav.use: Zyada resistant bacterial infection: sinus, chest, skin, UTI.
amoxiclav.dose: Adult: 625 mg (500/125) din mein 2-3 baar, doctor ke anusar.
amoxiclav.timing: Khane ke pehle kaur ke saath, taaki pet kam kharab ho.
amoxiclav.side_effects: Loose motion, ulti, rash; kabhi liver enzymes badhna.
amoxiclav.food: Khane ke saath lene se side effects kam hote hain.
amoxiclav.avoid_if: Penicillin allergy, pehle isi dawa se liver problem hui ho.
amoxiclav.warnings: Poora course khatam karein. Rash ya saans mein dikkat par turant doctor.

azithromycin.name: Azithromycin
azithromycin.use: Gale, chest, skin aur typhoid jaise kuch infection.
azithromycin.dose: Adult: aam taur par 500 mg din mein ek baar 3 din ke liye; infection ke hisab se doctor tay karte hain.
azithromycin.timing: Roz ek hi time par; goli khane ke saath ya bina le sakte hain.
azithromycin.side_effects: Pet dard, loose motion, ulti; kabhi dil ki dhadkan mein badlav (QT).
azithromycin.food: Antacid (Gelusil, Digene jaise) se 2 ghante ka gap rakhein.
azithromycin.avoid_if: Liver disease, QT problem, macrolide allergy.
azithromycin.warnings: Domperidone/ondansetron ke saath QT risk. Course poora karein.

ciprofloxacin.name: Ciprofloxacin
ciprofloxacin.use: UTI, pet ke infection, typhoid, kuch chest infection.
ciprofloxacin.dose: Adult: 250-750 mg din mein 2 baar, infection ke hisab se.
ciprofloxacin.timing: Khali pet ya khane ke 2 ghante baad; akele doodh ke saath nahi.
ciprofloxacin.side_effects: Ulti, loose motion, chakkar, tendon (nas) mein dard, dhoop mein jaldi jalna.
ciprofloxacin.food: Doodh, dahi, calcium, iron, antacid se 2 ghante pehle ya 6 ghante baad lein.
ciprofloxacin.avoid_if: Pregnancy, bachche, tendon problem, epilepsy, myasthenia gravis.
ciprofloxacin.warnings: Tendon ya jodon mein dard ho toh dawa band karke doctor ko batayein. Glimepiride jaisi diabetes ki dawa ke saath sugar gir sakti hai.

doxycycline.name: Doxycycline
doxycycline.use: Acne, chest/urinary/skin infection, malaria bachav, scrub typhus.
doxycycline.dose: Adult: 100 mg din mein 1-2 baar, doctor ke anusar.
doxycycline.timing: Khane ke baad poore glass pani ke saath. Lete hi lete mat jayein (gale mein atakne se jalan).
doxycycline.side_effects: Ulti, acidity, gale mein jalan, dhoop mein jaldi jalna.
doxycycline.food: Doodh, antacid, iron, calcium se 2-3 ghante ka gap.
doxycycline.warnings: Dhoop se bachein. Sone se kam se kam 30 minute pehle lein.

metronidazole.name: Metronidazole
metronidazole.use: Amoebiasis, giardia, dant aur pet ke anaerobic infection, bacterial vaginosis.
metronidazole.dose: Adult: 400 mg din mein 3 baar, aam taur par 5-7 din.
metronidazole.timing: Khane ke baad (dhaatu jaisa swad aur ulti kam hoti hai).
metronidazole.side_effects: Mooh mein dhaatu jaisa swad, ulti, sir dard, gehra peshab.
metronidazole.food: Course ke dauran aur khatam hone ke kam se kam 48 ghante baad tak alcohol bilkul nahi (ulti, dhadkan tez, chehra laal).
metronidazole.avoid_if: Liver disease, nerve problem; pregnancy ke pehle 3 mahine mein doctor se poochein.
metronidazole.warnings: Poora course khatam karein. Haath-pair mein sunnpan ho toh doctor ko batayein.

metformin.name: Metformin
metformin.use: Type 2 diabetes mein sugar control; PCOS mein bhi doctor dete hain.
metformin.dose: Adult: 500 mg se shuru, din mein 1-2 baar; doctor dheere badhate hain. Max aam taur par 2000-2550 mg/din.
metformin.timing: Khane ke saath ya turant baad.
metformin.side_effects: Ulti, loose motion, pet gas, mooh mein dhaatu jaisa swad; lambe use mein B12 kam ho sakta hai.
metformin.food: Alcohol se bachein (lactic acidosis ka risk).
metformin.avoid_if: Severe kidney ya liver disease, heart failure.
metformin.warnings: Contrast dye wali scan ya surgery se pehle doctor ko batayein. Doctor ke bina band na karein.

glimepiride.name: Glimepiride
glimepiride.dose: Adult: 1-2 mg se shuru, subah; max 4-8 mg/din doctor ke anusar.
glimepiride.timing: Subah naashte ke saath ya pehle bade meal ke saath.
glimepiride.side_effects: Sugar kam hona (kaampna, pasina, bhookh, chakkar), vajan badhna.
glimepiride.food: Meal skip na karein. Alcohol se sugar bahut gir sakti hai.
glimepiride.avoid_if: Type 1 diabetes, severe kidney/liver disease, sulfa allergy.
glimepiride.warnings: Sugar kam lage toh turant meethi cheez (glucose, juice) lein aur doctor ko batayein. Meal skip karna khatarnak hai.

amlodipine.name: Amlodipine
amlodipine.dose: Adult: 5 mg din mein ek baar (range 2.5-10 mg).
amlodipine.timing: Roz ek hi time par; khane se farak nahi padta.
amlodipine.side_effects: Pair/takhne mein sujan, sir dard, chehra laal hona, dhadkan tez, chakkar.
amlodipine.avoid_if: Severe aortic stenosis, bahut kam BP.
amlodipine.warnings: BP normal aane par bhi doctor ke bina band na karein.

telmisartan.name: Telmisartan
telmisartan.use: High blood pressure, heart aur kidney protection.
telmisartan.dose: Adult: 40 mg din mein ek baar (range 20-80 mg).
telmisartan.timing: Roz ek hi time par, khane ke saath ya bina.
telmisartan.food: Potassium supplement ya salt substitute doctor se poochkar hi lein.
telmisartan.warnings: Pregnancy ki planning ho toh doctor ko batayein. NSAID (ibuprofen, diclofenac) ke saath kidney risk.

atenolol.name: Atenolol
atenolol.dose: Adult: 25-100 mg din mein ek baar.
atenolol.side_effects: Dhadkan dheemi, thakaan, thande haath-pair, chakkar.
atenolol.avoid_if: Asthma/COPD, heart block, bahut dheemi dhadkan, uncontrolled heart failure.
atenolol.warnings: Achanak band na karein (BP aur dhadkan tez ho sakti hai). Diabetes mein sugar kam hone ke lakshan chhup sakte hain.

atorvastatin.name: Atorvastatin
atorvastatin.use: High cholesterol, heart attack aur stroke se bachav.
atorvastatin.dose: Adult: 10-40 mg din mein ek baar (max 80 mg).
atorvastatin.timing: Roz ek hi time par; aam taur par raat ko.
atorvastatin.side_effects: Muscle dard/kamzori, pet gas, liver enzymes badhna.
atorvastatin.food: Grapefruit juice zyada na lein; alcohol kam karein.
atorvastatin.warnings: Gehra muscle dard ya kaala peshab ho toh turant doctor ko batayein.

montelukast.name: Montelukast
montelukast.use: Asthma ka control aur allergic rhinitis.
montelukast.dose: Adult: 10 mg din mein ek baar.
montelukast.side_effects: Sir dard, pet dard; kabhi mood badlav, neend mein dikkat, bechaini.
montelukast.warnings: Mood ya vyavhaar mein badlav ho toh doctor ko batayein. Asthma attack mein turant raahat ke liye nahi hai, reliever inhaler chahiye.

salbutamol.name: Salbutamol
salbutamol.use: Asthma/COPD mein saans phoolne par turant raahat.
salbutamol.dose: Inhaler: 100 mcg ke 1-2 puff zarurat par, doctor ke anusar.
salbutamol.timing: Saans phoolne ya khansi hone par. Spacer ke saath behtar kaam karta hai.
salbutamol.side_effects: Haath kaampna, dhadkan tez, sir dard, gala sukhna.
salbutamol.avoid_if: Salbutamol allergy; heart rhythm problem mein dhyan.
salbutamol.warnings: Agar roz zyada puff lene pad rahe ya raahat na mile toh turant doctor ya emergency. Atenolol jaisi beta-blocker iska asar kam karti hai.
salbutamol.storage: Inhaler ko garmi aur dhoop se door rakhein. Chhed na karein aur aag ke paas na rakhein.

levothyroxine.name: Levothyroxine
levothyroxine.dose: Dose har mareez ke TSH blood test par nirbhar hai; doctor tay karte hain.
levothyroxine.timing: Subah khali pet, naashte se 30-60 minute pehle, pani ke saath.
levothyroxine.side_effects: Zyada dose par dhadkan tez, ghabrahat, vajan girna, neend na aana.
levothyroxine.food: Chai/coffee ke saath na lein. Calcium, iron, antacid se kam se kam 4 ghante ka gap.
levothyroxine.avoid_if: Uncorrected adrenal problem, recent heart attack mein doctor se.
levothyroxine.warnings: Roz ek hi time par lein. Dose khud na badlein. TSH test doctor ke kehne par karwayein.

loperamide.name: Loperamide
loperamide.use: Bina bukhar aur khoon wali acute loose motion.
loperamide.dose: Adult: shuru mein 4 mg, phir har loose motion ke baad 2 mg; bina prescription max 8 mg/din.
loperamide.avoid_if: Khoon wali dast, tez bukhar, antibiotic se hui dast, 2 saal se kam bachche, severe pet dard.
loperamide.warnings: 48 ghante mein theek na ho toh doctor ko dikhayein.

prednisolone.name: Prednisolone
prednisolone.use: Asthma flare, allergy, arthritis, autoimmune aur sujan wali bimariyan.
prednisolone.dose: Dose bimari par nirbhar hai; hamesha doctor ke likhe anusar.
prednisolone.side_effects: Acidity, bhookh aur vajan badhna, mood badlav, neend na aana, sugar aur BP badhna; lambe use mein hadiyan kamzor.
prednisolone.food: Namak kam, calcium-rich khana achha hai.
prednisolone.avoid_if: Serious infection bina doctor ke, active ulcer mein dhyan.
prednisolone.warnings: Lambe course ke baad achanak band na karein. Diabetes mein sugar badh sakti hai.

albendazole.name: Albendazole
albendazole.dose: Adult: aam taur par 400 mg ek baar (single dose); doctor ke kehne par dohra sakte hain.
albendazole.timing: Chikne (fatty) khane ke saath behtar absorb hoti hai.
albendazole.side_effects: Pet dard, ulti, sir dard; kabhi liver enzymes badhna.
albendazole.warnings: Poore parivaar ki deworming ke liye doctor ki salah lein.

clopidogrel.name: Clopidogrel
clopidogrel.use: Heart attack, stroke aur stent ke baad clot se bachav.
clopidogrel.dose: Adult: 75 mg din mein ek baar (kabhi shuru mein loading dose doctor dete hain).
clopidogrel.timing: Roz ek hi time par, khane ke saath ya bina.
clopidogrel.side_effects: Aasani se neel padna, bleeding (naak, masude, peshab ya potty mein khoon), acidity.
clopidogrel.warnings: Stent ya heart ke mareezon mein bina doctor ke kabhi na rokein. Surgery/dental se pehle doctor ko batayein. Omeprazole se bachein.

iron.name: Iron + Folic acid
iron.use: Anaemia (khoon ki kami) aur pregnancy mein supplement.
iron.dose: Aam taur par elemental iron 100-200 mg/din ya doctor ke anusar; folic acid alag dose mein.
iron.timing: Khali pet behtar (nimbu pani/vitamin C ke saath). Pet kharab ho toh khane ke saath.
iron.side_effects: Kabz, kaala potty (normal), ulti, pet dard.
iron.food: Chai, coffee, doodh, calcium se 2 ghante ka gap.
iron.avoid_if: Iron overload (haemochromatosis); thalassemia mein bina doctor ke nahi.
iron.warnings: Bachchon ki pahunch se door rakhein, kyunki iron overdose bachchon mein khatarnak hai. Levothyroxine, ciprofloxacin, doxycycline se gap rakhein.

vitamind3.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
vitamind3.use: Vitamin D ki kami, hadiyon ki kamzori, calcium absorption.
vitamind3.dose: 25-OH Vitamin D level ke hisab se doctor tay karte hain. Aam taur par 60,000 IU hafte mein ek baar kuch hafte, phir maintenance.
vitamind3.timing: Chikne wale khane ke saath behtar absorb hota hai.
vitamind3.side_effects: Sahi dose par kam. Zyada lene par calcium badhna, ulti, kamzori, kidney stone ka risk.
vitamind3.food: Doodh aur fatty khane ke saath achha.
vitamind3.avoid_if: High calcium level, kidney stone history mein doctor se poochkar.
vitamind3.warnings: Bina test ke lambe samay tak zyada dose na lein.
